# The UNESCO Courier

> > UNESCO's flagship magazine covering global issues, indigenous knowledge, sustainability, and cultural heritage since 1948, published in 6+ languages.

The UNESCO Courier features in-depth articles on climate change, traditional knowledge systems, human rights, and cultural diversity. Notable contributors include thought leaders like Kate Raworth, Tahar Ben Jelloun, and profiles of influential figures such as Nelson Mandela and Isamu Noguchi, with special focus on regions including Africa, Brazil, China, and indigenous communities like the Sámi people and Kalahari cultures.

## Key Topics

- UNESCO Courier magazine
- Indigenous knowledge and traditional medicine
- Climate change and sustainability
- Multilingual global publication
- Human rights and dignity
- Cultural heritage and diversity
- Africa and South Africa
- Sámi people and Kalahari cultures
- Brazil and China coverage
- Anti-racism and freedom struggle
- Dai medicine and traditional knowledge
- Kate Raworth and economic thought
- Nelson Mandela legacy
- Apartheid and anti-apartheid movement
